highlights.title: 企业 AI 的护城河，开始长在连接与治理层，而不是模型层
highlights.body: 今天最清晰的共识不是谁的模型更聪明，而是企业一旦真的要把 agent 放进工作流，采购门槛立刻转向连接器、身份治理、计费和权限。Thibault 那条面向团队的方案介绍，把“能连进公司系统”和“能被公司管起来”放在同一层；Aaron Levie 则把这层直接定义为 applied AI 公司的价值窗口。因果关系很直接：模型能力可以被替换，但接入组织上下文并稳定穿过安全与管理要求，才决定 AI 能不能从试用变成常驻。

evidence.quote: So much demand for this one. Works similar to the Pro $100 plan but designed for teams and small companies. All ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex features. Connect to Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Microsoft 365, and more. Secure workspace with SAML, SSO, and MFA. Centralized billing and administration. Usage analytics and spend controls. No 5h limits
It’s clear that there’s a wide gap between the AI models and the underlying workflows of an enterprise, which leaves a ton of opportunity for applied AI companies.

This requires understanding the context, driving the change management, having a harness that can route to various models, connecting to the critical business systems in that vertical, solving the UX challenges of connecting users to agents in the right way in a workflow.

highlights.title: 跨界面记忆会变成 agent 标配，但默认开启的前提是边界先被产品化
highlights.body: Claude 这轮更新的重点不是“终于有 memory 了”，而是把 memory 从单点功能改成贯穿多表面的连续性层，同时把查看、编辑、删除和敏感主题开关全部显式化。也就是说，厂商已经默认用户要的是“少重复解释自己”，但也承认一旦记忆跨越聊天和执行面板，隐私边界必须先被界面化。真正的产品分水岭不在记住更多，而在能否让用户清楚地知道系统记住了什么、没记住什么。

evidence.quote: Claude now has one memory across chat and Claude Cowork, and you decide what's in it. Hand Cowork a task and it starts from what Claude already knows from your chats.
Everything Claude remembers is saved as a list of topics in Settings, where you can read, edit, or delete each one. Memory also updates on its own as you chat, saving new details as they come up.
Topics some consider sensitive, like health or religious beliefs, stay out of memory unless you turn them on in Settings.

highlights.title: Agent 真正的瓶颈，已经不是会不会写代码，而是能不能被安全地放权
highlights.body: 一边是 Swyx 直接提醒大家别碰不稳定的 locked use，本地能力失控会把问题放大到钥匙串级别；另一边是 Guillermo 在推 secure eval 和 secure connectivity，把执行环境和服务接入都当成一等问题。两条信号合起来说明，agent 竞争正在从“能生成什么”切到“能安全地代做什么”。当产品开始碰本机、账户和外部服务时，权限模型和隔离策略不再是工程细节，而是用户是否敢真的交权的前提。

evidence.quote: do not use codex "locked use" capabilities right now. it is currently relying on unstable mac features and has completely locked me out of my macos keychain twice this week.
The hardest problem in building agents is secure connectivity to services and data.

We're introducing Run SDK: secure eval for dynamic Code Mode execution. When agents write code, you don't always need a full sandbox. You can run their code in a lightweight QuickJS secure context. Faster and more cost-efficient.

highlights.title: 搜索和 Web 基础设施，会被 agent 当成主要用户后重做一遍
highlights.body: Parallel 这期播客里最关键的判断，是把 agent 当作与人类不同的第一类客户：如果主要流量变成 agent，搜索反馈就不能再靠 human click data，索引、排序甚至商业模式都要重写。这不是在浏览器上加一层自动化，而是在倒逼 Web 基础设施为机器使用者重新设计。谁还按 human UI 和 human feedback 来建 agent 产品，后面会越来越像在旧公路上硬跑新车。

evidence.quote: Our view at Parallel is that human click data is a bug, and agent doing work with search should rely on agent feedback, not human feedback.
evidence.attribution: Parag Agrawal（播客《Parallel’s Parag Agrawal: Building a New Web for AI Agents》）

evidence.quote: We started Parallel with the bet that agents would do it a thousand x more than humans ever have. As a result, we need to reinvent the technology that can power search for agents, but also the business models that go alongside it.
